benchmark_name: Preselected Conjugation-2A 1sg past attestation challenge v17

answer_sources.attested_context: Geelii oo i soo eegaya, ayaan galbeed foolka aaddiyay, dhabarkana bari.
answer_sources.feature_resolution: The surrounding passage is sustained first-person narration, including kaligey and waan xusuustaa. In the target clause ayaan resolves the narrator as first-person singular; the completed narrative event supports past.

The lesson directly glosses the utterance as 'I have sprayed a poison' and separately lists Buufiyay = Sprayed. The baan construction and first-person English gloss resolve 1sg; the completed-event gloss supports past.

unresolved_targets.reason: Searches found afceliyay in third-person contexts, but no trustworthy explicit context was found that safely resolves the selected token to first-person singular. No surface is inferred from the C2A pattern.

experimental_design.purpose: Test the unsupported C2A 1sg past cell on preselected long-authorized class lemmas, scoring only explicit person-resolved attestations and leaving unresolved targets unjudged.

independence_limits.reason: v17 uses two unrelated post-registry answer sources. The benchmark answers remain evaluation-only; any generic 1sg runtime rule must be authorized from separate development evidence.

notes: PR #50 merged the answer-free target registry before any 1sg answer lookup.
